metadata.Description: A French-German document-level comparable corpus of news articles from 20Minuten/20minutes.
metadata.Paper Title: 20min-XD: A Comparable Corpus of Swiss News Articles
Affiliations: Department of Computational Linguistics, University of Zurich
metadata.Abstract: We present 20min-XD, a French-German document-level comparable corpus of news articles sourced from the Swiss online news outlet 20 Minuten/20 minutes. Our dataset comprises around 15,000 article pairs spanning 2015 to 2024, automatically aligned based on semantic similarity. We detail the data collection process and alignment methodology. Furthermore, we provide a qualitative and quantitative analysis of the corpus. The resulting dataset exhibits a broad spectrum of cross-lingual similarity, ranging from near-translations to loosely related articles, making it valuable for various NLP applications and broadly linguistically motivated studies.
